description: Figure 5 is a bar chart that illustrates the performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated by comparing the performance gap between VisuoThink with and without rollout search. The chart shows the performance gain for different tasks, with the x-axis representing the tasks and the y-axis representing the performance gain in percentage. The bars in the chart are color-coded to represent different tasks, and the height of each bar indicates the performance gain for that task. The chart is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of predictive rollout search in improving the performance of VisuoThink.
